changes.reasonJa: 固定WEB 2KI 1:17は、ヨシャファトの子ヨラムをユダ王として、イスラエル王ヨラムと区別して名指す。knownByと紹介文をこの明示初出へ移し、8:16の即位紹介は後続factとして既存の後段内容を保つ。
changes.sourceText: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

changes.reasonJa: 固定WEB 2KI2:12の「イスラエルの戦車と騎兵」は集団用法の先行例。3:3/3:6/3:24/3:27/7:13も全文照合で確認した集団用例のため追加し各factを当該節でゲート。国/領域用法とヤコブ個人文脈は混ぜない。

evidenceVerses.text: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.
Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.
King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”

changes.before: 同時代のイスラエル王ヨラム（アハブの子）ではなく、ユダ王ヨシャファトの子。本文は「ヨラム」と「ヨラム」の転写を使い分ける。
changes.after: この節では、ヨシャファトの子ヨラムをユダの王として記します。
changes.reasonJa: knownBy 2KI1:17 ではユダ王ヨラムの名と父が示されるが、同時代のイスラエル王ヨラムとの比較は2KI3:1以降の情報なので常時表示から除いた。
